title.narrative: From 2021 to 2024, Peru increased adolescent health care coverage from 3.7% to 12.2%. This progress resulted from collaboration between the Ministry of Health and Ministry of Economy and Finance. UNICEF supported 11,740 students with health promotion, policy development on menstrual, school, and mental health, and the BESSI-45 study.
